$comment: Single source for completion, hover, signature help and diagnostics. Sources: CPQ 12 macro language reference manual ('M p. N') and Macro-Based BRC guide ('BRC p. N'). Upper case names also accept their lower case form; other names are exact. In a syntax, lower case words are parameters (listed in the same order in 'params'), [x] is optional, [A|B] is an optional keyword choice and upper case words are literal keywords.

entries.name: DEFINE
entries.description: Defines a macro. Parameters are passed by reference; the macro returns a value by assigning the variable that has its name.

entries.name: IF
entries.description: Runs statements depending on a condition. A whole block may fit on one line: IF x LET y 1 END_IF.

entries.name: ELSE_IF
entries.description: Additional conditional branch of an IF block (any number, before ELSE).

entries.name: ELSE
entries.description: Branch run when no condition of the IF block is true (at most once).

entries.name: WHILE
entries.description: Loop that checks its condition before each pass, so the body may never run.

entries.name: REPEAT
entries.description: Loop that checks its condition after each pass: the body always runs once, then again while the UNTIL condition stays false.

entries.name: UNTIL
entries.description: Ends a REPEAT loop and gives its stop condition.

entries.name: EXIT_LOOP
entries.description: Leaves the current WHILE or REPEAT loop.

entries.name: LET
entries.description: Gives a value to a variable or an array element, creating the variable if needed. Short form: name := expression.

entries.name: LOCAL
entries.description: Declares a variable that only exists inside the macro.

entries.name: DELETE

params.name: name
params.description: name (string) of the variable, array or macro

entries.description: Frees a variable, an array or a macro.

entries.name: DELETE_VAR
entries.description: Frees every variable of the current environment.

entries.name: DELETE_MACRO
entries.description: Frees every macro of the current environment.

entries.name: IsArray
entries.description: True if the value is an array.

entries.name: IsDefined
entries.description: True if the variable is defined (false, for instance, when a Java method returned null).

entries.name: IsEqual
entries.description: True if the variable is defined and equal to the value.

entries.name: IsNumber
entries.description: True if the value is a number.

entries.name: IsObject
entries.description: True if the value is an object.

entries.name: IsString
entries.description: True if the value is a string.

entries.name: IsInArray
entries.description: Tests whether a value belongs to an array. Not documented in the manual.

params.name: name
params.description: name or path of the environment ("super" and "root" are accepted)

entries.name: CREATE_ENVIRONMENT
entries.description: Creates an environment and makes it the current one.

entries.name: LIST

params.name: environment
params.description: environment to list (current one by default)

params.name: detail
params.description: NAME for names only, DETAIL for definitions (default)

entries.description: Lists the content of an environment (and the fields of an object).

entries.name: DELETE_ENVIRONMENT
entries.description: Deletes the environment and its children.

entries.name: DISPLAY

params.name: expression
params.description: value to write; in a BRC, name of the result array between quotes

entries.description: Writes a value to the output channel. In a BRC, DISPLAY "array" returns the array to the constraint engine.

entries.name: ERROR

params.name: message
params.description: message sent to the error channel

entries.description: Stops the macro and sends a message to the error channel.

entries.name: MESSAGE
entries.description: Writes to the message channel without stopping the macro.

entries.name: DaysBetween
entries.description: Number of days between two ACDate dates (global function).

entries.name: TRACE

params.name: mode
params.description: DEL_OLD (or SUPP_ANC) overwrites the file, CONCAT_ANC appends to it

params.name: file
params.description: file name, often built by concatenation

entries.description: Opens a trace file for the following statements.

entries.name: STR
entries.description: Converts a number to a string. Also written STR(x).

entries.name: Lpad
entries.description: Pads a string on the left up to the given length.

entries.name: Rpad
entries.description: Pads a string on the right up to the given length.

entries.name: TRIM

params.name: side
params.description: LEFT or RIGHT; without it, both ends are trimmed

entries.description: Removes blanks at the start and/or the end of a string.

entries.name: REPLACE_STR
entries.description: Replaces every occurrence of a string.

entries.name: StringFnawk
entries.description: Splits a string into a one-line array: tab[1,n] with n from 1 to tab[1,"NF"].

entries.name: CHERCHER_CHAINE
entries.description: Searches for a substring. Not documented in the manual.

entries.name: SQL_QUERY
entries.description: Runs a query and stores the result: ["NR"] rows, ["NF"] columns, [0,j] column names, [e,c] values.

entries.name: IsConnected
entries.description: True if the channel is connected to a database.

entries.name: SqlConnectPool2
entries.description: Connects a channel to a connection pool (read only).

entries.name: SqlCloseCreatedPools
entries.description: Closes the pools created by the instance.

entries.name: SqlReadTable
entries.description: Runs a stored query (with or without parameters); same result layout as SQL_QUERY.

entries.name: DecimalRound

entries.description: Rounds a value to the given number of decimals.

entries.name: EXP
entries.description: e raised to the given power.

entries.name: NUMBER
entries.description: Converts to a number; 0 for a non numeric string.

entries.name: POWER
entries.syntax: a POWER b  |  a ** b  |  a ^ b

entries.name: TRUE
entries.description: True (stored as 1, but cannot be compared with 1).

entries.name: FALSE
entries.description: False (stored as 0, but cannot be compared with 0).

entries.name: root

entries.name: DEL_OLD

entries.name: LEFT

entries.name: RIGHT
